name: sql_database

args.query:
CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS
SELECT
    cohort_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
    (SELECT example_comment FROM participants.contact_notes WHERE participants.cohort_id = cohort_summary.cohort_id LIMIT 1) AS example_comment
FROM
    participants
GROUP BY
    cohort_id;
